name: Sakuradamon
tagline: Tokyo in 9 minutes and Otemachi in 9 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 9 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 19 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 21.4 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.6 m to 26 m, a difference of 21.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 1 pharmacy. The nearest facility recorded as a hospital is 浩邦会日比谷病院, about 992 m from the station. The next nearest is 虎の門病院, about 1126 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Sakuradamon is ahead on quiet.

leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
